name: rakshak-tests
description: Automated tests run against the local Firebase emulators (needs Java).

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-rakshak "cd tests && tsx --test firestore.rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix ../functions run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-rakshak "node tests/functions.smoke.cjs"
